title: Visiting Professor of Law
bio: Madhav Khosla is the B. R. Ambedkar Professor of Indian Constitutional Law and Professor of Political Science at Columbia University. He is also a Senior Fellow at the Knight First Amendment Institute at Columbia University, a member of the Columbia University’s Committee on Global Thought, and the Faculty Director of the B.R. Ambedkar Program in […]
